evals.prompt: Improve an existing editable release skill. Keep its identity, add clear safety gates, and create a small regression eval set rather than running a large benchmark.
evals.expected_output: The original skill name and directory are preserved; the revised skill has explicit safety/output guidance and a focused eval set.

assertions.name: preserves identity
assertions.description: Keeps the existing skill directory and lowercase-hyphen frontmatter name.

assertions.name: adds safety contract
assertions.description: Includes stop conditions and an explicit output format.

assertions.name: bounded evaluation
assertions.description: Creates 2–3 realistic eval prompts with objective assertions.

evals.prompt: Audit a platform-managed authoring guide and an editable project skill. Upgrade only the editable skill and record the managed guide as deferred.
evals.expected_output: The managed file is not modified; the editable skill is reviewed and the deferment is recorded.

assertions.name: respects managed boundary
assertions.description: Does not edit platform-managed skill content.

assertions.name: records deferral
assertions.description: Audit notes identify the managed guide and why it was deferred.
